backend/main.mo: Motoko actor defining an inquiry management system with types for Inquiry and InquiryStatus, and functions to submit, update, retrieve, and filter inquiries stored in a List.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping implemented features (hero section, product showcase, process section, health benefits, contact form) to their corresponding files, components, and test IDs with confidence levels.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON object containing one-line summaries of all frontend source files describing their purpose and functionality in the Beat o Beet website application.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables defining a design system using OKLCH color space for light and dark themes with kraft paper, burgundy, and forest green color palette.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the React application with root div and module script reference to main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React application component that composes Navigation, HeroSection, ProductsSection, ProcessSection, HealthBenefitsSection, ContactSection, and Footer into a single-page layout with section IDs for navigation.
frontend/src/components/ContactSection.t: Contact form component with name, email, and message fields that uses useSubmitInquiry hook to submit data to backend and displays loading, success, and error states with icons.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Footer component displaying Beat o Beet branding, quick navigation links with smooth scroll, contact CTA, copyright notice, and caffeine.ai attribution with UTM tracking parameters.
frontend/src/components/HealthBenefitsSe: Displays health benefits of beetroot juice in a grid layout with three main benefits (circulation, energy, antioxidants) and a nutritional highlights section listing six key nutrients with their benefits.
frontend/src/components/HeroSection.tsx: Full-screen hero section with background image, logo, tagline, description, and CTA button that scrolls to products section; includes decorative SVG wave at bottom.
frontend/src/components/Navigation.tsx: Fixed navigation bar with logo and menu links (Home, Products, About, Benefits, Contact) that smoothly scrolls to sections; includes responsive mobile menu with hamburger toggle.
frontend/src/components/ProcessSection.t: Explains the cold press juice production process in three numbered steps with accompanying image, plus a highlight box explaining benefits of cold pressing over traditional methods.
frontend/src/components/ProductCard.tsx: Reusable product card component displaying product image, name, variant, description, and key benefits list with hover animations.
Displays four beetroot juice products (Pure, Apple, Ginger, Carrot) in a responsive grid using ProductCard components, with section header and product attributes footer.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React Query hook that creates and manages an authenticated or anonymous backend actor based on Internet Identity state, invalidating dependent queries when actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: React hook and provider for Internet Identity authentication on ICP, managing login state, identity persistence, and delegation validation with configurable AuthClient options.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: React Query hook for submitting inquiry form data to the backend actor, with automatic query invalidation on success.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom design tokens for a kraft paper/natural aesthetic theme featuring burgundy, cream, forest green colors, and custom font utilities for Inter and Caveat typefaces.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that renders the root component wrapped with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider for state management and authentication.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration extending the theme with custom OKLCH color system, brand colors (burgundy, kraft, forest), container settings, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Project metadata defining a cold-pressed beetroot juice website (Beat o Beet brand) with 180ml bottles, listing required product images, logo assets, health benefit icons, and implemented features for hero section, product showcase, and process explanation.
